articles.title: PREVIEW: Panthers want sticks to stay hot vs. Canucks
Injury Update: Markstrom, Gudas still day-to-day, targeting returns on Oct. 21

away.summary: The Seattle Kraken (5-2-1) are projected to start Joey Daccord in net, with Philipp Grubauer as backup. They will be without defensemen Brandon Montour (lower body), Jacob Melanson (upper body), and Ryan Lindgren (upper body), plus scratched players Curtis Douglas and Ty Nelson. The team is coming off a strong road trip where goaltending has been a key factor, but they need to improve third-period consistency.

returning: : Markstrom will return and start after missing two games with an undisclosed injury.
home.summary: The Florida Panthers (4-2-2) project Jacob Markstrom to start in goal, with Akira Schmid as backup, after he missed two games with an undisclosed injury. They will be without Aleksander Barkov (knee), Brad Marchand (knee), Jonah Gadjovich (neck), and Radko Gudas (lower body). The Panthers are targeting a return for Markstrom and Gudas on Oct. 21 against Ottawa, but Markstrom is expected to start this game.
